subject.title: [Feature]: Route node alerts using active-computer presence

question: Should gateway-owned recent node activity become the canonical selector for node connection alerts while existing general node-tool defaults remain unchanged?
rationale: The feature moves notification ownership from every macOS client into the gateway and introduces operator-activity telemetry across stable protocol, gateway, model-context, and native-app surfaces; implementation cannot safely choose that product boundary without owner intent.

options.title: Centralize alerts only
options.body: Use activity recency for gateway-owned connection-alert delivery and stable active-node context without changing unrelated implicit node selection.

options.title: Centralize all defaults
options.body: Use recent activity for connection alerts and general implicit node selection across tools.

options.title: Keep client alerts
options.body: Retain independent macOS notifications and expose activity only through node inventory or diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Centralize alerts only
recommendation.body: Use activity recency for gateway-owned connection-alert delivery and stable active-node context without changing unrelated implicit node selection.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to every central surface involved: macOS presence, native node notification execution, gateway node routing, and implicit node selection.
